elNinoFinding: The only El Nino in 2021-2026 (2023-24) came while inflation was falling: food inflation ended 4.2 to 6.5 percentage points below the projections made during it. The data therefore cannot estimate how much an El Nino raises CALABARZON food prices, and the score cannot include it (E68).
evaluation: Lead-2 back-test, 50 province-quarters in 10 quarters (2024-Q2 to 2026-Q3), all examined before E68: accuracy 0.72 (36/50), balanced 0.68. No E68 correction beats it by the pre-registered rule; the 75% goal is not met on valid evidence. The forecasts of every E68 variant for 2026-Q4 and 2027-Q1 are sealed for scoring when the outcomes are published.
faceValidity: PSA subsistence incidence (2021, 2023) is the only independent provincial measure in the system; with five provinces per year and sampling errors up to 62% it cannot confirm or reject the province ordering.
